Bacio di Latte, a global gelato chain, plans to open a location in Belmont Shore by taking over the former Holey Grail space at 4803 E. 2nd St in Long Beach. The article does not provide an opening timeline and Bacio di Latte did not respond to inquiries.
Holey Grail, a Hawaii‑based taro doughnut brand, opened its first Long Beach shop at 4803 E. 2nd St in June 2024 and later closed abruptly amid reports of unpaid rent.

data.location: 3299 E. Williams Field Road, Gilbert, AZ 85295
data.short_description: Salad and Go is set to reopen its former Gilbert location at 3299 E. Williams Field Road. Partners aim to take possession in the first week of November 2026 and open within about 45 days, pending approvals.
Salad and Go plans to reopen its Mesa location at 1040 W. Southern Avenue. A reopening date has not been announced.

data.location: 12169 Fair Lakes Promenade Dr, Fairfax, VA 22033
data.short_description: Piccolo Buco by Cooper’s Hawk is considering a Fairfax County location at 12169 Fair Lakes Promenade Drive. The lease has not been signed yet, and the opening timeline cannot be estimated. The article notes the potential lease signing is just over the horizon.

data.status: still visibly has considerable work to be done
data.short_description: Crafted 81 plans to open a new restaurant in Madison’s Kayo Center development in Gluckstadt. The 7,000‑square‑foot venue will serve pizza, tacos and smash burgers and is expected to open in March 2027. The article states the restaurant still has considerable work to be done.

Little Moose Creamery in Frisco opened a soft opening on October 4, 2026 at 5501 Preston Road, Suite 120. The ice‑cream shop is receiving strong community response and is preparing for its grand opening. The piece highlights its premium soft‑serve offerings and in‑house waffle cones.

data.location: 1305 W Main St, Battle Ground, WA 98604
data.status: set to open around the first week of January 2027
data.short_description: Brewed Awakenings will add a new coffee shop at 1305 W Main St in Battle Ground, slated to open around the first week of January 2027. The company also plans additional locations in Camas and La Center later in 2027. The Battle Ground site will be part of the West Main Commons mixed‑use development.

Z Bistro filed a state license to open a restaurant at 2018 16th St in Midtown Sacramento. No opening date has been announced, but the application indicates plans to serve beer, wine and food. The building currently houses Wing Fa Market, and it is unclear if the market will close.

Flaming Pizza has filed papers to open a location at 4141 Hacks Cross Road, suite 109 in Memphis. The certificate of occupancy application is listed as “in review” as of October 22, and no opening timeline is provided.
iWingz is planning a new restaurant in downtown Salem, and its website lists the location as “coming soon.” No opening date has been announced.
The iWingz that operated at 2445 25th St. SE in Salem closed on June 27 after lease issues. The business continues serving customers via a food truck while seeking a new permanent location.

data.location: The Belle Commons in the Oxford Commons community, right off frontage road
data.status: does not yet have a set opening date
data.short_description: Vicksburg‑based Rusty’s Riverfront Grill announced plans to open a second location called Rusty’s Oxford in The Belle Commons retail development in Oxford, Mississippi. The new restaurant will feature the same menu with an emphasis on seafood and is expected to be customer‑ready by April of next year. No specific opening date has been set.

Buren Bakery announced plans to open a second location in Old Town Spring at 419 Gentry Street, Suite 204. The new space will feature a larger indoor dining area and is expected to open later this year or early next year. The bakery is also considering a location in Puerto Rico.

Fuel Coffee’s Montlake storefront at 2300 24th Ave E will reopen as Taru Coffee & Play, a café with an indoor children’s play area. The new owners plan a soft opening in fall 2026 after temporarily closing on October 1. The concept will serve coffee, pastries, and a menu for families.

data.status: opening date is still being evaluated
data.short_description: Owners of a concept called 6112 Hospitality have submitted a liquor license application for 6112 N Lincoln Avenue, the former Evita Steakhouse space. The new restaurant, backed by chefs Tyler Nickson and Sebastien Simon, is planned to occupy both floors, but an opening date is still being evaluated.
The former Evita Steakhouse, which occupied 6112 N Lincoln Avenue, moved to a new address on McCormick Boulevard and closed not long after the move.

The h.wood Group is opening Lady Delilah, a 10,000‑square‑foot Art Deco supper club, at 353 West 14th Street in Manhattan’s Meatpacking District. The venue will feature American bistro fare, cocktails, live music and performances and is scheduled to open on November 3. It will be the brand’s fifth location and the group’s first in New York City.

Judge Bean’s BBQ announced it will close its doors for good on November 14, ending 16 years of operation in Brentwood. The owner said the final farewell celebration will begin at 5 p.m. on that date. The restaurant has been a cultural hub for the Brentwood and South Nashville neighborhoods.

data.status: construction is expected to start toward the end of next month and wrap up by the end of the year
data.short_description: Starr Bakery is transitioning from a mobile pop‑up to its first permanent brick‑and‑mortuary storefront at 8141 Highway 6, Building A in Missouri City. A permit shows construction is expected to start toward the end of next month and finish by year‑end, with the bakery slated to debut this winter or early 2027. Co‑founder Anthony Hicks is listed on the permit.
The article profiles Zinqué’s concept, history, and expansion but does not mention a specific opening or closing event for any location.

data.status: targeting to open sometime this fall
data.short_description: Ari & Lloyd is a planned dual‑concept American bistro and cocktail lounge presented by owner Katie Schnurr. The concept is targeting to open sometime this fall. No exact opening date is provided.

data.status: will open next month in the Muse Apartments
data.short_description: Matcha House is an independent café concept slated for downtown Phoenix. The brand recently announced it will open next month in the Muse Apartments. No exact date is given.

data.status: just celebrated the opening of its most recent location this past weekend
data.short_description: PRESS Coffee, an Arizona specialty coffee roaster, recently celebrated the opening of its newest café location this past weekend. The article does not provide a specific opening date.
Tipsy Scoop, known for alcohol‑infused ice cream, recently debuted a new shop in downtown Phoenix. No exact opening date is mentioned.

data.status: launched his second location in Glendale recently
data.short_description: HTeaO, a beverage franchise, launched its second Glendale location recently under TZONA, LLC. The article does not specify an exact opening date.

Grand Fir Brewing is planning a second taproom at 15252 S.E. Oregon 224 on the edge of Damascus and Happy Valley. The team is waiting on permits and doing light renovations before opening the doors this fall. The new 1,100‑sq‑ft taproom will feature a large smoker, beer garden, solarium, and food trucks.
Good Neighbor, a Baltimore shop, plans its first DC location at 429 8th St SE. The article notes the building size and that no opening timeline is available yet.

data.location: 209 E Orangefair Mall, Unit 11, Fullerton, CA 92832
data.short_description: BAQBA Mexican Grill is preparing to open a fast‑casual Mexican restaurant at 209 E Orangefair Mall, Unit 11 in Fullerton. A plan review has been filed, but no opening date is provided.
Loud’n Roasted is set to open a new cafe space at 2309 Woodland Crossing Drive in Herndon, replacing the former Meanwhile Coffee site. The article says an opening timeline cannot be projected.
Souplantation may reopen at 11179 Talbert Ave in Fountain Valley, occupying about 7,800 sq ft in The Shoppes at Costco Plaza. No specific opening date has been announced.
The team behind Puma Yu’s will launch a cocktail bar called Hin and a daytime cafe Hin in Athens’ Five Points, with plans to open in 2027. No further details on location or design are provided.

Lobbie, a bar and restaurant concept by Blaxton, is set to open inside the terminal at Québec City Jean Lesage International Airport. The airport announced the project for winter 2027, with the venue to be located after security near gates 29 and 30 and seat up to 75 guests.

Shaker Cuisine & Mixologie is planning a new restaurant in Val‑d’Or at 1830 3e Avenue. The paperwork has been signed but the project has not been officially confirmed and no opening date has been announced.

data.location: 6862 E Mount Vernon St, Glen St Mary, FL 32040
data.short_description: Burger King is preparing to open a new restaurant at 6862 E. Mount Vernon St. in Glen St. Mary, Florida. Details on size, drive‑thru configuration and opening timeline have not been released.

The Donut Guy’s Sandhill location in the Village at Sandhill is closing after about three years of operation. The closure was announced via a Facebook post stating “The Donut Guy Sandhill is closing”.

data.status: hoping to be open within the next 30 days
data.short_description: The brand will relocate to Winnsboro under the name Donut Guy Express, with hopes to open within the next 30 days, though the new address has not been disclosed.

Ford’s Garage is preparing to open a second St. Johns County restaurant at 102 Beachwalk Boulevard in St. Johns, Florida. No opening date has been announced and the location does not yet appear on the company’s website.

Burrell & Flynn’s Farm is converting the former Old Montmorenci Winery at 3057 Charleston Hwy in Aiken, SC into a new restaurant called Burrell & Flynn’s Farmhouse Kitchen. The space is currently undergoing extensive restoration and renovation, and no opening date has been set yet. The farm plans to source fresh, seasonal produce for a lunch and dinner menu.

Crooked Cow Creamery, a Cape Coral‑based ice‑cream food truck, has submitted plans to open a brick‑and‑mortar location at 2330 Palm Ridge Rd, Unit 9 in Sanibel, FL. The new restaurant will offer a range of classic, THC‑, CBD‑, and alcohol‑infused ice‑cream flavors. No opening date has been announced.

data.location: 1661 Estero Blvd #11-14, Fort Myers Beach, FL 33931
data.status: opening is being targeted for December
data.short_description: Sol Tequila will take over the former Mr. Tequila space at 1661 Estero Blvd, Suites 11‑14 on Fort Myers Beach, FL. Plan review documents show the restaurant is targeting an opening in December. Details beyond the location remain under wraps.

data.status: preparing to hit the streets in Central Florida Soon
data.short_description: Bob’s Caribbean BBQ, an Idaho‑based Jamaican food truck, is preparing to relocate to Central Florida, with potential bases mentioned in Winter Haven and Poinciana. The owners have not disclosed a specific address or opening date. The truck will continue serving authentic Jamaican cuisine after the move.

A new Dunkin’ is planned for 405 Serano Way in Nokomis, FL, across from Northeast Venice Park. Construction is slated to start in December, with the opening projected for mid‑to‑late Q1 2027. The announcement also highlighted new seasonal menu items.

data.status: Looks to be preparing for a new location
data.short_description: Priceypoo Bakery currently operates at 3880 Tamiami Trail, Suite A in Port Charlotte. Plan review documents show a proposed new location at 3755 Tamiami Trail, Suite B. No comment was given and an opening date has not been announced.

Fuel Coffee’s Montlake location at 2300 24th Ave E will reopen as Taru Coffee & Play, a café with an indoor children’s play area. The new owner announced a temporary closure beginning October 1 and a soft opening planned for fall 2026. The space will serve Stamp Act coffee, pastries, and an expanded menu for adults and children.

Huey Magoo’s is planning a new drive‑thru restaurant in Princeton, Texas, located in an end‑cap space at Princeton Meadows, 1560 W. Princeton Dr., Suite 107. Interior construction is slated to begin in December with completion expected in early 2027.
